about: The pinned TeX Live snapshot B1's builder takes its packages from (scripts/build-bundle.mjs; docs/DESIGN.md#engine-and-data). One pin covers the whole snapshot: the SHA-256 of tlpkg/texlive.tlpdb.xz. Every package archive is then checked against the SHA-512 that this tlpdb lists for it, so a mirror can change nothing unnoticed. The pin itself is taken only after TeX Live's signature vouches for the tlpdb: the bundle workflow's pin job verifies tlpkg/texlive.tlpdb.sha512.asc with gpg against the key whose fingerprint 'signingKey' pins, and the builder checks that the signed SHA-512 is the fetched tlpdb's. The pin job prints the 'tlpdb' entry (sha256, signedSha512, signatureChecked); a person reads its licence lists and commits it. The builder refuses to run without 'sha256' and 'signatureChecked'. The snapshot is a dated copy of TeX Live's tlnet (texlive.info keeps one per day); the mirrors are tried in order.

signingKey.name: TeX Live Distribution
signingKey.source: https://tug.org/texlive/verify.html (the fingerprint TUG publishes); the key itself from keyserver.ubuntu.com or keys.openpgp.org
